response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development, full-stack engineering, and AI-agent infrastructure, including work with MCP and developer tooling, which aligns well with the role's GenAI and cloud focus. However, his resume lacks explicit evidence of production-grade AI solution building, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent systems—key requirements. His background in TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS) partially covers the tech stack, but his recent GenAI-specific contributions are not clearly demonstrated.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering background with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS)
Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure, including MCP and developer tooling
Proven leadership in technical discovery, mentorship, and engineering excellence
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases or RAG architectures in prior work
Limited evidence of multi-agent system frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)
No clear indication of building and shipping production-grade AI solutions

key_factors.factor: Cloud platform expertise (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
